A7_A9_architectural_note.A7: mapping/governance authentication's real analog is Fabric's chaincode-lifecycle governance itself: RoleMapping/RoleThreshold are compiled into the chaincode, so changing them requires the channel's real 2-of-2 (Org1MSP+Org2MSP) endorsement policy for chaincode commit -- already exercised for real 11+ times this session (v2.1 through v2.11, each requiring both orgs' approval, visible via querycommitted). Not ablatable per-transaction: it is deployment-time governance, not application logic.
A7_A9_architectural_note.A9: TOCTOU protection is Fabric's own platform-level optimistic concurrency control (MVCC read-set validation at commit), automatic for every GetState call -- already demonstrated real (2026-09-21 concurrency_toctou_experiment.md; 2026-09-23 E4 non-policy-relevant control). Not ablatable per-transaction without disabling Fabric's own commit-time validation entirely, a channel-level setting outside any chaincode's control.
